notes.title: Controller support and updated engine released!
notes.content:
We have released the controller support & engine updates advertised last year on the main branch! As previously discussed, this adds support for controllers in line with the support added to our recent Xbox release. It also updates the game to the latest version of Visionaire, which has been shown to resolve some CTDs that people were experiencing before.

In addition to those core changes, it also addresses a few minor art issues and smooths certain puzzle solutions. Nothing major.

If you experience any new crashes with this build, please let us know. The "legacy" branch can be activated in the Steam beta branch settings at any time to switch back to the pre-update code.

notes.title: Coming Soon: Update 1.1.0 (now in open beta)
notes.content:
Hello detectives!

As mentioned quite a while ago, we've been working on a new update for NNL. The primary goal for this update was to upgrade our engine to the newer version to hopefully address some of the more fundamental bugs that players have run into, such as odd cursor behaviour on Mac and various rare crashes. Since we haven't been able to replicate these ourselves, an engine update is all we can really do in terms of addressing them.

While that was in progress, we also got an opportunity to add controller support to the game. Progress on that is going extremely well, and is more or less complete. Some puzzles (such as the KK peanut grab) have been streamlined to be more accessible on controller, hotspot sizes have been increased as needed, text has been increased in size to be readable at TV distance, and lots more! Note that only Xbox controllers are officially supported through this system, but this does still mean that Steamdecks should work flawlessly. We can't easily get one where we live, so unfortunately we can't verify that, but if you own one - give it a shot!

Finally, we've fixed a few more bugs that people have reported, such as Oscar disappearing if you use a particular combination of items and being unable to talk to certain characters in Bee's room if you're standing in a particular spot, and achievements not working for GOG. We are also taking a look at the audio levels of some of the voice to see whether we can address any especially loud lines which people have complained about. Do not, however, that lines which sound a little softer at the start are not targeted for change, as those are mostly due to actor performance and delivery, and are as expected. But if you have specific lines you think need a fix, do let us know!

Most of this - especially the controller support - is available for beta testing right now! Simply switch to the "controller" branch on Steam. Do note that this is currently only being updated for Windows. Work is ongoing, with updates a few times a week still, so minor bugs can still be expected (and no work has yet been done to the audio on it). Also note that due to the engine upgrade, save games *might* break. We are unsure about this. In order to let people keep using their old saves after the update goes live, we have added a "legacy" branch on Steam which contains the old build. If you run into strangeness on existing saves, switch to "legacy" and see if it works there. Our official recommendation is going to be to play a new save with the new release.

Thanks for playing!

Cuddles & Tabby

notes.title: Nine Noir Lives releasing September 7, 2022
notes.content:
Pretoria, South Africa (July 7, 2022) — Today, independent developer Silvernode Games is purring with delight, as they are announcing that their comedy-noir “point-and-lick” adventure game, Nine Noir Lives, will claw its way onto PC via Steam and GOG on September 7, 2022. Cat lovers and adventure game aficionados alike are invited to pounce into the furry, delicate, yet capable paws of Cuddles Nutterbutter and unravel a fun — and occasionally fiendish — feline mystery set in the beautifully hand-drawn city of Meow Meow Furrington.

The story, themes, and tone of Nine Noir Lives draws its inspiration from several very different sources, including classic film noir, Shakespeare, and the absurdist comedy style of writer and director Taika Waititi. This unlikely combination allowed Silvernode Games to craft a unique, comedic adventure grounded by more serious subject matter. 

In Nine Noir Lives, players will take on the role of Cuddles Nutterbutter, a feline private investigator with a taste for solving crime… literally. Cuddles will poke, talk, and lick his way through his toughest investigation yet: a murder case that threatens to upset the tenuous relationship between the paw-erful Montameeuw and Catulet crime families. Along the way, players will interact with dozens of fully-voiced characters, beautifully hand-drawn scenes, and devious puzzles to answer the most important question of all: how many things need to be licked to solve a murder in this town?

Fueled by a lifelong passion for point-and-click adventure games, the two person team at Silvernode Games has been hard at work creating a love letter to the most beloved games in the genre like Grim Fandango and Broken Sword. Nine Noir Lives builds on everything that came before it, adapting elements from other classic adventure games to create an experience that is simultaneously familiar and fresh. 

“Nine Noir Lives is a passion project we’ve been self-funding for several years now,” said William Kruger, Founder of Silvernode Games. “We set out to make the sort of game that we always wanted to get lost in. It’s been a real labor of love, and we can’t wait for players to step into our cat-filled world when the game launches in September.”

Key Features of Nine Noir Lives Include:

[olist]
[*] [b]Brought Up on Feline-y Charges[/b]: A charming comedy-noir storyline set in the unique and intriguing city of Meow Meow Furrington, inspired by every cat ever and with fewer cat puns than you might expurrct.
[*] [b]A Point-and-Lick Adventure[/b]: Discover a whole new dimension to everything in the game by using Cuddles’ tongue. Lick first, and ask questions later. Questions like "what did you expect that to taste like, Cuddles?"
[*] [b]S’more Cats Equals S’more Fun[/b]: Experience the city from two very different perspectives as you switch between Cuddles and his trusty assistant, Tabby Marshmallow.
[*] [b]Purrfect Voice Acting[/b]: Laugh and learn about the world of Furth with over a hundred thousand words of fully-voiced dialogue performed by an all-star cast including Lucas Gilbertson (Megaman X), Carol-Anne Day (A Hat in Time) and SungWon Cho (Borderlands 3, God of War Ragnarok).
[/olist]

For a taste of what to expect from Nine Noir Lives, watch the latest trailer that introduces the struggle between the two most powerful families in Meow Meow Furrington.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PAqKUfJEZA0

Nine Noir Lives will launch for PC and Mac via Steam and GOG on September 7, 2022. A demo is available now.

If you’d like to conduct your own investigation into Nine Noir Lives, be sure to follow the game on [url=https://twitter.com/NineNoirLives]Twitter[/url].

notes.title: Casting call: Henchtigers
notes.content:
[u][b]Intro[/b][/u]
We have some characters we need to cast - and we're opening it up to under-represented voices! We’re especially interested in lesser-known accents and dialects, people with speech impediments or vocal handicaps, or any vocal flavour that has made you think your voice isn't beautiful.

We want you for our game, and we'll pay you! We’re paying [b]150 CAD[/b] for about[b] 360 words[/b] of recording. Because everyone deserves to be heard.

[u][b]Character Description[/b][/u]
The henchtigers are the muscle for one of the nasty criminal elements that operate in the cat city of Meow Meow Furrington. Due to a shortage of actual tigers, most of them aren't tigers at all, but just orange tabby cats. They keep using the name, though, because it's more intimidating. However, they are still ordinary cats at the end of the day, and the lines in this audition show that through a very mundane, low-stakes interaction.

[u][b]Deadline for Submissions[/b][/u]
The deadline for submissions is the [b]4th of July 2020 at 6pm GMT[/b].

[u][b]Further Details & Script[/b][/u]

notes.title: Cats, comedy, and crime...welcome to Nine Noir Lives!
notes.content:
Nine Noir Lives is a comedy-noir "point-and-lick" adventure game, set in a city of talking cats.

Play as Cuddles Nutterbutter, second-best PI in town and owner of two definitely normal-sized paws. Armed with your wits, your assistant Tabby Mashmallow, and a tongue that's ready for anything, you'll talk, puzzle and lick your way across the cat city of Meow Meow Furrington to solve a murder that threatens to upset the delicate balance between the Montameeuw and Catulet crime families.

Our demo is a thirty-minute slice from near the start of the game, selected to give you a taste of what you can expect when the full version releases next year - without spoiling anything 😺 It includes full English voice acting, and text translations into both German and Afrikaans.

NNL has been a four-year labour of love for Silvernode, with just the two of us working on it in our spare time, with assistance from contractors all over the world. We just love adventure games, and we're thrilled to finally be able to show our take on the genre to everyone. So please: brush your whiskers, shake your tails, lick your paws clean and dive into Nine Noir Lives!

notes.title: Steam Game Festival, June 9 - 14
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that [b]Nine Noir Lives[/b] will be a part of the Steam Game Festival this June!

From the 9th to the 14th, you'll have a chance to download and play a short part of the game and start getting to know Meow Meow Furrington and the characters that live there :)

The demo will be part of the game's opening chapter, intended to ease players into point-and-clicks, so it's not terribly challenging, but it gives you a good idea of what to expect from the game :) It includes full English voice acting, as well as text translations into German and Afrikaans, just as the final game will.

We will also be hosting a developer Q&A on our Discord (https://discord.gg/pGTsDpD) during the Festival, where we'll answer your questions, share information about the game's development, and generally just have a good time :) Hope to see you all there!
